close_reason: Single pinned record, commit 13740c55; no behaviour change
description:
## Question

Replace the `releases` table, `versionOf`, `matchingPreludeVersion` and `isSupported` in `nix/buck2/buck2-source.nix` with one pinned record (buck2 version, prelude version, source rev, protos hash). Resolve the buck2 binary and prelude from turnkey's own toolbox/teller at exactly those versions, ignoring the consumer's registry. Rewire every consumer of the old API (flake.nix declaredBuck2, nix/flake-parts/turnkey/default.nix prelude resolution, nix/devenv/turnkey/buck2.nix test-runner/protocol + the 'caching is off' warning, turnkey-test-runner, test-runner-protocol). Done when all gates pass with buck2 no longer read from any toolchain.toml.

comments.text: From turnkey-luk.1: pin buck2 and buck2-prelude by date (2026-09-15, never "default"), add preludeRev = 4d101dce3482c35b32f9f1e7072b354ae789d256 to the pinned record and assert the resolved prelude's passthru.preludeRev matches at eval. Missing/wrong prelude entries get fixed in toolbox, not overridden here.

Resolution: commit 13740c55 (on top of main, not pushed). buck2-source.nix is one pinned record (version 2026-09-15, rev, protosHash, preludeRev) with buck2/upstreamPrelude/protos resolved from turnkey's own registry (turnkeyFlakeLib.defaultTellerRegistry; the flake-parts module's turnkeyLib is rebound to the teller lib in perSystem, which broke evaluation mid-change). The preludeRev check and missing-entry errors are exercised. Verified no behaviour change: turnkey-prelude, turnkey-test-runner and protocol drvs identical to main; the default shell is identical modulo checkout path; buck2 --version in the shell reports the pinned rev 6507dd15. All CI gates pass. Left for turnkey-luk.6: the buck2 binary on PATH and shellNeedsBuck2 still read toolchain.toml; buck2Source.buck2 is ready for it.

title: Collapse buck2-source.nix to a single pinned buck2 release
